{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Shore Marshes''' were located [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] west of [[Gelgelar Free Port/Legends|Gelgelar Free Port]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] shallow [[Water/Legends|seas]] meet the swamps in the marshes, and the area is avoided by local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] because they believed the area was home to mysterious figures and beasts of large size.
